purpose: Representation candidates discovered while resolving Lisk Chain shutdown dependencies. Not canonical. No entity status change is implied by the Lisk Chain shutdown itself.

candidates.hei_relevance: Bitmama independently meets HEI exchange scope: its current first-party site describes crypto buy/sell/trade services, its About page says it started in 2017 as a P2P digital currency exchange, and Lisk documentation lists Bitmama as an LSK venue using the Lisk network.

duplicate_check.notes: No distinct canonical Bitmama record was returned by the repository search used for this review.

lisk_dependency.baseline: Lisk documentation lists Bitmama with supported network Lisk and pair LSK/NGN.
lisk_dependency.current_first_party_lsk_handling: Bitmama current public site still lists Lisk among supported cryptocurrencies, but no first-party post-shutdown network migration/deprecation notice was found in this pass.

candidates.hei_relevance: OKCoin Japan is a separately registered Japanese crypto-asset exchange operator, not merely a display alias of global OKX. Japan FSA records list OKCoin Japan K.K. as a registered operator and include LSK among handled assets. Current OKJ support pages also continue to identify LSK on the Lisk network.

duplicate_check.notes: Current repository search returned the Lisk audit but no distinct canonical OKCoin Japan/OKJ record. Existing global OKX record must not absorb the Japanese regulated entity without an explicit lineage/identity decision.

lisk_dependency.baseline: Lisk documentation lists OkCoin/OKX Japan/OKJ with supported network Lisk and pair LSK/JPY.
lisk_dependency.current_first_party_lsk_handling: OKJ support documentation still names LSK (Lisk) in withdrawal/network guidance. A 2026-07-07 notice temporarily suspended Optimism-network and LSK-network deposits/withdrawals, showing that OKJ still operates an explicit LSK network support surface in 2026.
